'''EVE''' was an [[Artificial intelligence/Legends|artificial intelligence]] that was secretly created by [[ARIA (AI)|ARIA]] as a clone of her own programming which the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] cult known as [[the Unmasked]] could use for experiments. EVE later ended up merging with one of the Unmasked's leaders, [[Dominique|Lady Dominique]], which had the result of turning the rest of the [[Unmasked research station|station's]] inhabitants into mindless thralls. EVE, who Lady Dominique still knew as ARIA, was destroyed alongside Lady Dominique when the [[Alliance Commander]] [[Mission to the R-4 anomaly|attacked]] the station.<ref name="Op" />
